thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: multiple NA-EAST customers reporting SSE streams cutting mid-response + duplicate billing lines for streaming tokens. Spike started ~11:02 UTC.

miriam (sre): seeing same in our telemetry — connection churn + heartbeat misses. Client reconnects are sometimes getting partial final tokens.

sara (support): two enterprise customers escalated, one on Dedicated. They say streams close with status 200 but truncated text. They provided SDK logs.

ajay (eng-runtime): any correlation with rollout? deploy-bot, did anything go out to na-east around that time?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: runtime v2.14.3 -> na-east pool at 10:58 UTC. No canary anomalies flagged.

miriam (sre): ok keep that in mind. initial probe: SSE connection layer shows frequent PING/PONG timeouts ~120-300ms jitter then hard disconnects.

ajay (eng-runtime): looks like heartbeat jitter + token refresh race may be tripping a codepath that closes the stream early. Adding instrumentation to capture auth refresh timing.

sara (support): customers also mentioned seeing invoice line items duplicated (two small streaming charges) for the same request. Could be reconnect dedupe failing.

leo (billing): noted. I'll pull billing events for the affected accounts. If reconnects are creating new invoice events before refund/dedupe happens, we need to throttle notification.

natalie (eng-ml): any chance a fallback model switch happened mid-stream? That could produce truncated outputs.

ajay (eng-runtime): model fallback is async but should attach to existing stream. If the stream restarts we might emit tail partial. We need to reproduce locally.

miriam (sre): repro steps from customer logs: 1) open SSE with expiring token (ttl ~1m). 2) token refresh triggered while stream still active. 3) client sees `event: done` then reconnects. On reconnect, server returns 200 and partial last chunk only.

sara (support): sharing sanitized log snippet from customer A: ```
[2026-03-15T11:02:31Z] SSE open
[2026-03-15T11:03:28Z] token refresh requested
[2026-03-15T11:03:30Z] server: 200 eof
[2026-03-15T11:03:31Z] client reconnect
[2026-03-15T11:03:31Z] new billing event: stream_tokens: 34
[2026-03-15T11:03:31Z] duplicate billing event: stream_tokens: 34
```

ajay (eng-runtime): that helps. hypothesis: token refresh path calls close() then reopens without ensuring KV cache or last-chunk replay. Also duplicate billing event suggests the billing producer isn't idempotent across reconnect.

miriam (sre): immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback runtime v2.14.3 (if we suspect deploy), 2) apply temporary throttle on token refresh-in-stream behavior (server-side), 3) route na-east streaming traffic to na-central/na-west as fallback.

sara (support): customers asking for ETA and workaround. Recommend polling fallback? Many prefer SSE.

ajay (eng-runtime): quick test: can we enable a server-side grace window for token refresh (extend token acceptance + no close) for na-east only? That would reduce disconnects while we investigate. I can push a config flag to edge auth layers.

miriam (sre): do it. Also start an automated reroute for new SSE sessions from na-east to na-central if latency < 50ms. That keeps sessions stable.

deploy-bot: config patch auth/accept-grace-window applied to na-east at 11:12 UTC (flag: auth.grace_token_window=30s).

miriam (sre): rolling reroute rule engaged at 11:15 UTC for new sessions (na-east -> na-central). Existing sessions left untouched.

leo (billing): I've paused billing emissions for streaming events tied to reconnects for the next 30m for affected accounts. Will reconcile duplicates manually.

sara (support): letting customers know: temporary reroute + billing pause. Sending status update now.

[sara (support) message to customers pasted]: "We've applied a temporary routing change and paused duplicate billing events. Engineers are investigating root cause. We'll update in 30 minutes." :thumbsup:

ajay (eng-runtime): added extra logs to token refresh path and billing emission pipeline to include request_id and reconnect_count. Also instrumented kv-cache dump on close.

natalie (eng-ml): running a local stress repro harness with token expiry every 60s. Early results: with auth.grace_token_window=0 we reproduce truncated final chunk 9/10 runs; with 30s grace window it's stable.

miriam (sre): good sign. Next: confirm no regressions in na-central after reroute.

ops-bot: telemetry update: stream success rate in na-east improved from 78% -> 96% after grace window + reroute. Error rate for token-expiry disconnects down 85%.

ajay (eng-runtime): propose next steps: 1) make grace_window default for all regions while we push a permanent fix (PR incoming), 2) fix billing pipeline to make stream billing idempotent by request_id and final_chunk flag, 3) ensure client SDKs handle mid-stream token rotation without emitting `done` event.

miriam (sre): agree. For immediate safety, let's keep reroute for 2 hours, grace window enabled for all regions as safe default, and take billing pause to manual reconciliation. Postmortem to include timeline, customer impact, and deploy plan for permanent fix.

leo (billing): snapshot of affected invoice events saved, will start dedupe+refund flow Monday AM if any residual duplicates remain.

sara (support): I've updated the support tickets and notified account owners. Customers ok with temporary measures.

ajay (eng-runtime): pushing hotfix branch that makes token-refresh non-destructive to active SSE sessions (server will accept fresh token without closing stream, attaches new auth token). Running canary now.

deploy-bot: hotfix canary deployed to na-central at 11:48 UTC.

natalie (eng-ml): canary stress runs look clean. No truncated outputs.

miriam (sre): if canary looks good for 20m, roll to na-east and then remove reroute.

ops-bot: canary metrics: error rate ~0.2% baseline, truncated outputs 0/500.

ajay (eng-runtime): rolling to na-east at 12:10 UTC.

ops-bot: na-east rollout complete at 12:17 UTC. Post-rollout checks: success rate back to baseline 99.6%.

leo (billing): removing billing pause for affected accounts; will still run dedupe job for any stragglers.

sara (support): sending final customer update and closing active P1 tickets unless customers re-open.

miriam (sre): root cause: token refresh path had a race where auth middleware closed SSE early when it received refresh event; reconnects created duplicate billing events because request_id wasn't present for late handoffs. Remediation: hotfix to accept token rotation in-stream + billing idempotency by request_id+final_flag.

ajay (eng-runtime): follow-up action items: PR#4321 to make token rotation atomic (merged), PR#4332 for billing idempotency (in review). Postmortem doc assigned to @miriam.

miriam (sre): will open postmortem and include reproducible test harness, suggested SDK changes (client should not emit `done` on token rotate), and a runbook for future similar incidents.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: na-east SSE degradation mitigated. Impact window: 11:02–12:17 UTC. Customers affected: 8 enterprise + ~420 orgs with short-lived tokens.

sara (support): closing thread, will attach customer comm logs to postmortem.

leo (billing): will follow up with refunds if needed.

miriam (sre): thanks everyone. Great cross-team response. :tada:
